typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination1_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		Team as string,
		Function as string,
		Driver as string,
		Description as string,
		Count as string,
		EFFDATE as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FlatFileSource
FlatFileSource derive(loadDate = currentTimestamp()) ~> DerivedColumn2
DerivedColumn2 sink(input(
		Function as string,
		Description as string,
		EFFDATE as string,
		Driver as string,
		Team as string,
		Count as string,
		loadDate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy'
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,batchSize: 5000,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		Function,
		Description,
		EFFDATE,
		Driver,
		Team,
		Count,
		loadDate),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination1_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination1
